title: Zesty Crispy Dutch Rice Vermicelli Noodles
description: A tangy and crispy post-workout Dutch dish featuring rice vermicelli, wood-fired-baked to perfection, this gluten-free-friendly meal is a great way to refuel after a workout.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the rice vermicelli according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked rice vermicelli to the bowl and toss to combine.
Spread the vermicelli mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes or until crispy.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped scallions.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
